source_lineage.provenance: R20 execution freeze native_and_tool_refs and annotation build receipt
fixed MMVQ source contract in src/heterollm_sim/mmvq_work.py

findings.proven_fact: Native backend graph compute executes once per scheduler split; standard planner paths set aggregate invocation_count to one and do not bind n_splits or split topology.
findings.current_behavior: Correct only conditionally when the invocation has exactly one split and no callback graph views.
findings.narrow_fix: Require a recorded split ledger and lower submissions/CP work plus inter-split event dependencies per split.
findings.test: Two-split fixture emits two submit/CP tasks and the second obeys predecessor completion; missing ledger reports uncovered.

findings.proven_fact: Ordinary server output invokes llama_synchronize, ending in CUDA stream synchronization across scheduler backends; planner completion marker has zero service and no host scheduler/wait demand.
findings.current_behavior: GPU completion remains on the output dependency path, but host synchronization-call occupancy and all-backend boundary are not represented.
findings.narrow_fix: Add source-qualified host_backend_synchronize task after all split completion events; keep service unknown until independently measured.
findings.test: Shared-host-resource fixture prevents a later caller sharing the sync thread from passing the explicit boundary.

findings.proven_fact: When an MMVQ weight compute buffer has allocated tail padding, source enqueues cudaMemsetAsync before Q8_1 conversion and vector dot; planner contract has no buffer usage/allocation/padding predicate.
findings.current_behavior: The current two-unit conversion plus GEMM topology undercounts by one asynchronous memory command whenever the source predicate is true.
findings.narrow_fix: Record compute-buffer usage and allocation/data byte counts; emit clear -> conversion -> dot only when padding is proven positive.
findings.test: Padding-zero fixture has two units; positive-padding fixture adds a clear unit with exact predecessor ordering.

findings.proven_fact: compiled_cuda_graphs=false does not disable direct-path ggml fusion or CUDA stream fork/join; a successful fuse skips later graph nodes.
findings.current_behavior: No frozen node-to-fusion/stream ledger exists, so one semantic tensor task per launch and fully serial lowering cannot be claimed native-count or overlap correct.
findings.narrow_fix: Freeze a graph node/fusion/stream ledger and coalesce only source-proven launch units.
findings.test: Fused and unfused ledger fixtures verify task cardinality and event-derived join edges without timing assertions.

prohibited_inference: No service time is inferred from kernel-union duration.
No service time is inferred from host wall duration.
No target-LLM measurement or refit is requested by this audit.
No absent launch, split, fusion, or synchronization fact is defaulted to a numeric value.
overall_assessment: Partially modeled but not source-count-certified. Existing aggregate frontend and per-lowered-kernel tasks are structurally useful, yet split count, host synchronization occupancy, conditional MMVQ clear, direct-path fusion, and multistream topology require additional frozen invocation evidence before native correctness can be asserted.
